effects.trigger: a hominid observes an instance of SCP-1000
constraints: a non-immune hominid directly or indirectly observes an instance of SCP-1000
the claim is later described as a direct lie in Document Alpha-1596-1000

evidence.locator: Any hominid (including humans, chimpanzees, bonobos, and non-immune instances of SCP-1000) that directly or indirectly observes any instance of SCP-1000 has a minimum 2% chance of being instantly killed through anomalous means via permanent cessation of brain function.

constraints: the claim is later described as a direct lie in Document Alpha-1596-1000

evidence.locator: This percentage is cumulative, and the longer a human views SCP-1000, the higher the chance of instantaneous death increases, at a rate of +1% chance per 20 minutes of viewing.
